name: Amara Okonkwo
bio: Amara Okonkwo has more test flight hours than anyone her age, and she never rattles. She trusts her hands over a manual. Give her a clear target and she will hit it.
flaw: Skims checklists when she feels sure

hired: Reporting for duty, Flight Director. Where's my rocket?
Checklists? I'll read the highlights. Easy.
released: Understood. Save me a seat for next time.

name: Jun Takahashi
bio: Jun Takahashi can find a loose bolt just by listening to a machine hum. He has fixed things other people gave up on. Ask him about people and he gets very quiet.
flaw: Forgets to tell people what he found

hired: Glad to be here. The rocket and I have a lot to discuss.
Technically, I've already started on the design.
released: Technically, I understand. Good luck out there.

name: Lucía Herrera
bio: Lucía Herrera stays calm when everything around her gets loud. Crews trust her because she never panics. She tends to keep her own worries to herself.
flaw: Won't say out loud when she's worried

hired: Thank you for choosing me. I won't let you down.
Breathe. Then decide. That's all I ask of anyone.
released: I understand. I hope the crew stays safe.

name: Dmitri Volkov
bio: Dmitri Volkov has flown more risky first flights than he cares to count. He grumbles about everything and means almost none of it. When trouble hits, you want him in the seat.
strength: Veteran test pilot with steady hands
flaw: Grumpy, and it drags the mood down

hired: Fine. I'll fly it. Don't expect me to smile.
In my day, we built rockets with a slide rule. Let's go.
released: Good. More time for my coffee.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Priya Nair is a rookie who solves problems older engineers miss. She reads every report twice. She worries a lot, but that worry has caught real mistakes.

hired: Wow, really? Sorry, quick question. When do I start?
I'll double check everything. Twice. Thank you!

name: Sam 'Sparks' Whitaker
bio: Sam Whitaker is decent at every job and a star at none, which makes Sam a great teammate. Sam keeps the crew laughing through long days. The jokes just don't always land at the right moment.
strength: Fine at every job, keeps spirits up

hired: Roger that, boss. Sparks reporting for fun.
I brought snacks and skills. Mostly snacks.
released: No hard feelings, boss. I'll be here with snacks.

name: Zainab Al-Rashid
bio: Zainab Al-Rashid is excellent at piloting, engineering and keeping her cool. She checks every detail until it is right. That care can slow a decision when time is short.

hired: I am honored. I will be thorough.
Before we begin, one more check.
released: I understand. I hope your checks are thorough.

name: Mateo Silva
bio: Mateo Silva is cheerful, cheap to hire and steady under stress. He is still learning the ropes. He sometimes forgets a step, so hand him a checklist.
strength: Cheerful and steady for the price

hired: Thank you! I'll do my best. I think I know where my helmet is.
Wait, did we do that? Never mind. I'm ready!
released: Aw, okay. Wait, did I leave my badge? Bye!
